title: Hall without a name on the plan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.2 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water; moved 1.6 m

by the hall kit: 9 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the back, front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

searched: This block has no name on the plan or in the texts, so no source can be searched for it by name.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label: a building stood here, its name unknown.
